layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Stiffened balance-tail morphology
features: A long, straight dinosaur tail held perfectly horizontal
Visible 'bony rods' (ossified tendons) made of light-colored clay running along the sides
The tail looks strong and rigid, like a wooden plank or a balance beam
At the base of the tail, large 'muscle lumps' connect it to the hips
Soft, rounded clay edges to keep the friendly aesthetic
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic side-view shot of the tail. To illustrate 'balance,' the dinosaur is standing on just one leg, using the stiff tail to stay perfectly level. The background is a soft, warm studio blur. No text.
